name: PulseBar System Monitor
subtitle: CPU, memory, disk and network
promotionalText: Live CPU, memory, storage and network readings in your menu bar. Customize rings and numbers, then open charts and app rankings.
description:
See your Mac’s status in the menu bar. Click or hover for charts and details.

• CPU, memory, memory pressure and swap
• Storage capacity, disk reads/writes and upload/download rates
• Automatic rate units or fixed MB/s, separately for network and disk
• GPU and internal-battery information on supported Macs
• Three customizable rings and individual numeric readings
• Refresh intervals from 1–60 seconds
• Performance events with optional notifications
• English and Simplified Chinese

App rankings and hardware temperatures require PulseBar Helper, available in Settings. Basic monitoring works without it.

Monitoring data and events stay on your Mac. No account or advertising.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Supports Apple Silicon and Intel. PulseBar updates through the App Store.
reviewNotes:
This update adds automatic or fixed MB/s display for network and disk rates, improves the Helper launch action and battery overview layout, and updates the app icon and interface text. The optional helper protocol, security requirements and version-pinned download are unchanged.

Menu bar system monitor. Click its readings for the overview; hover over CPU or Memory for charts and app rankings. Configure rings and numbers in Settings. No login or in-app purchases.

Basic metrics, charts and local events work independently. App rankings and temperatures require the optional PulseBar Helper: https://github.com/monaco-io/PulseBar/releases/download/helper-v1.0.2/PulseBar-Helper.pkg . The signed, notarized, script-free PKG installs only the helper in ~/Applications, without root privileges. The user opens it and chooses Enable Helper, with background-item approval in System Settings if needed. Disable Helper unregisters it before removal. Installation does not launch or enable the service.

The sandbox entitlement com.apple.security.temporary-exception.mach-lookup.global-name permits only 45Y6A23PTN.io.github.monaco-io.PulseBar.HelperService. Both ends verify Apple signatures, developer team 45Y6A23PTN, exact bundle identifiers and the same Unix user. IPC accepts only read-only usage/temperature samples, with no commands, paths, writes or process control.

The Store app excludes process/SMC readers and Sparkle. It opens the download in the browser; it does not download or execute the installer. The helper is separate. PulseBar updates through the App Store. Monitoring data stays local. Hardware readings depend on device support.

Support: https://github.com/monaco-io/PulseBar/blob/main/docs/HELPER.md
Privacy: https://github.com/monaco-io/PulseBar/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md
whatsNew:
Network and disk rates now offer Automatic or Fixed MB/s, with independent units for each direction. Paired menu bar rows each show their own unit; single rows keep full-size text.

Fixed opening PulseBar Helper from Settings and improved the first overview layout on Macs with a battery. Updated the app icon and simplified interface text.
